policy: Unknown fields, formulas, events, topics, and behavioral thresholds stay unresolved until named evidence is approved. No gap may be converted into a production default by inference.

items.reason: The reference API documentation does not enumerate endpoint-specific status codes or error envelopes.
items.resolutionEvidence: Captured read-only error responses or an approved authoritative API schema.

items.reason: Examples show populated success rows but do not prove target null, omission, or empty-result behavior for every field.
items.resolutionEvidence: Versioned response fixtures covering empty, partial, and unavailable market data.

items.reason: The candle example does not identify quote currency, volume denomination, gap-fill policy, or timestamp boundary semantics.
items.resolutionEvidence: Authoritative candle schema and time-aligned target samples.

items.reason: Frozen clients show event names and reconnect behavior but no verified target sequence, cursor, Last-Event-ID, or replay payload fields.
items.resolutionEvidence: Captured SSE transcript with disconnect, Last-Event-ID reconnect, and replay.

items.reason: Bundle-derived objects contain candidate fields beyond the published examples and their meaning is not authoritative.
items.resolutionEvidence: Approved field dictionary with type, unit, nullability, and provenance.

items.reason: No verified chain-56 ABI and topic registry for pcsv3, univ3, pcsv4, and univ4 is included in the evidence set.
items.resolutionEvidence: Pinned bytecode/address registry plus verified ABI artifacts and topic hashes.

items.reason: Factory, pool manager, pool, hook, and deployment ranges for the four protocol identifiers are not verified.
items.resolutionEvidence: Chain-56 deployment manifest tied to block ranges and code hashes.

items.reason: Exact indexed/non-indexed fields and protocol-specific amount sign conventions cannot be mapped without verified ABIs.
items.resolutionEvidence: Decoder golden fixtures matched to transaction receipts and state deltas.

items.reason: No approved BSC confirmation depth or operational finality source is present; fixture depth 2 is test-only.
items.resolutionEvidence: Operations decision recording confirmation depth, finality source, and rollback SLO.

items.reason: A raw log does not carry block timestamp and P02-01 does not contact an RPC to enrich it.
items.resolutionEvidence: Read-only block-header source contract with caching and reorg behavior.

items.reason: Active-TVL range, price, and liquidity inclusion rules require production-sample calibration per the function matrix.
items.resolutionEvidence: Versioned formula, reference samples, tolerance, and target-parity approval.

items.reason: Fee/aTVL cannot be defined until aTVL and target annualization semantics are approved.
items.resolutionEvidence: Approved aTVL plus ratio window and annualization specification.

items.reason: The designated token, supply source, price source, and rebasing/burn treatment for FDV are not evidenced.
items.resolutionEvidence: Versioned token designation and supply/price provenance rules with fixtures.

items.reason: Published examples expose TVL-like values but not the canonical balance snapshot and price source used at window end.
items.resolutionEvidence: Time-aligned pool balances, prices, target outputs, and approved tolerance.

items.reason: Thresholds, lookback windows, precedence, and stability rules for high-fee, stable, surge, decline, crowded, volatile, and LP-flow labels are not evidenced.
items.resolutionEvidence: Versioned label truth tables and target-output golden samples.

items.reason: The target bundles contain several watchdog intervals but no single authoritative stale-state threshold for every /pools surface.
items.resolutionEvidence: Approved per-stream liveness and UI state-transition specification.

items.reason: V4 PoolKey identity, hook effects, tick-spacing source, decimal conversion, and chart interpolation are not fully evidenced.
items.resolutionEvidence: Verified V3/V4 pool fixtures with expected tick chart outputs.
